Gill and Varma Win ICC Player of the Month Awards

Shubman Gill has been named the ICC Player of the Month for September, while Shafali Verma has won the award in the women's category. Gill achieved this recognition for his performances, including a double century against the West Indies. This marks a significant achievement for both cricketers.
